findings.note: The transaction creates `.resolver-staging/<nonce>` and fsyncs files and the nonce directory, but never fsyncs `.resolver-staging` after creating the nonce directory. A power loss can therefore preserve fsynced live-target renames while losing the nonce-directory entry and its journal, leaving an undetectable partial publication. This violates the crash-recovery and mixed-generation guarantees of REQ-001/AC-047.
